descriptions.zh:
初看，[From.GetName]上的一切都似乎平淡无奇。只有当[Root.GetName]上的一位科学家在一次偶然的观测中发现地表之下有一块巨大棱镜在反射星光。扫描仪很快对物体进行了辨识，它的宽度几乎相当于一座中等大小的岛屿。

探针遥测表明，构成该棱镜的化学物质具有非常高的价值；其物理结构可能在我们星系内也是独一无二的。
descriptions.en:
At first glance, everything about [From.GetName] seemed routine and normal. Only during a chance alignment did a scientist aboard the [Root.GetName] notice starlight reflecting off a vast lens near the surface below. Scanners were quickly trained upon the crystalline object, whose breadth is that of a moderately-sized island.

Probe telemetry suggests the chemical make-up of this lens is highly valuable; its physical structure may also be unique within our galaxy.

label.zh: 一种有用的资源，现在是我们的了。
label.en: A valuable resource, ours to exploit.

label.zh: 它罕见的美将会被所有人共同欣赏。
label.en: Its rare beauty should be left for all to enjoy.

descriptions.zh:
绝大多数[From.GetName]地表的景观确乎是运用了某种形式的美学设计。我们的科学家猜想即使是星球其余的“处女地”也不过是为了满足一个更广阔的园艺目标而被刻意雕琢成那样的。

在我们进一步的调查过程中，我们碰巧发现了一座信标，这是这整颗星球上唯一一个科技存在的例证。启动这座信标时，它上传了一份包含[From.GetName]上所有动植物品种的目录，以及一个指向邻近的[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的参考指针。但仍没有任何用来找到这颗行星的设计者的线索。
descriptions.en:
Some form of aesthetic design has been employed over most of the surface landscape on [From.GetName]. Our scientists suspect that even the remaining, 'untouched' areas are merely crafted wilderness - there to serve a wider horticultural goal.

Towards the conclusion of our research, we stumbled across a beacon - the sole example of technology on this world. When activated, it uploaded a catalog of every plant and animal species found on [From.GetName], as well as a reference pointer to nearby [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]. No clue was left with which to identify the planet's designers.

descriptions.zh:
若非庞大的规模以及与[Owner.Capital.GetName]之间遥远的距离，§Y[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]§!可能会被误认为是一座我们所建造的禅境。它的地表是一座宏大而风格独特的景观，点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。我们的学者注意到，其水体与陆地的外观呈现具有一种算术精确性。虽然无碍美观，但其确实偏离了自然的形态，而更像一种刻意的模仿。

无论其来源几何，这颗精心雕琢的星球与最近其表现上涌现的§Y园艺无人机们§!具有明确的关联。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。

也许我们被引到这颗禅境星球是一种暗示，这意味着我们日益增长的问题会在适当的时候被解答。
descriptions.en:
Were it not for its sheer scale and remoteness from [Owner.Capital.GetName], §Y[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]§! might be mistaken for a zen garden of our own making. Its surface is a vast, stylized landscape punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids. Our scholars note an algorithmic precision to its apparent depictions of water and land. It remains decorative, but somehow divorced from natural forms - like a studied imitation.

Whatever its origin, there is a clear link between this sculpted world and the §YGardening Drones§! which recently emerged from its surface. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have, however, yielded no results.

Perhaps our being led to this zen planet is a hint - that answers to our growing stack of questions may reveal themselves in due time.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]上巨大的几何形式显然不是自然形成的。这颗行星上别具一格的景观是无尽的沙海，上面点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。

我们的研究院认为，这种景观应该是一种艺术作品，或是一种仪式的产品。然而，唯一可能造成这些的只有我们此前发现的§Y园艺无人机们§!。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。也许只能等待时间给我们答案……
descriptions.en:
The vast, geometric forms on [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] are certainly not of natural origin. The planet's stylized landscape is reminiscent of a vast and dusty sea, punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids.

Our researchers conclude that this landscape is likely an art piece, or else is part of some ritual practice - however, the only perpetrators appear to be the §YGardening Drones§! we saw earlier. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have yielded no results. Perhaps time will tell...

descriptions.zh:
访问者：§Y欢迎来到温科沃特§!。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。

谨代表园丁并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的温科沃特美术堂生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。
descriptions.en:
Visiting entity: §Ywelcome to Wenkwort§!. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the Gardeners and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intrusion upon the biota of planetary designate Wenkwort Artem. Failure to comply with our guidelines will diminish the survival odds of all concerned.

options.script:
name = "federations3.121.a"
is_dialog_only = yes
response_text = federations3.121.a.response

label.zh: 无稽之谈。我们将按照我们认为合适的方式发展我们的殖民地。
label.en: Nonsense. We'll develop our colony as we see fit.

descriptions.zh:
妙啊！指导方针将会立刻发送给你。

总之：WAPP-715命令允许对温科沃特花园进行负责任的、非破坏性的使用。我们非常重视保护这些世界现有的特性，但是我们不希望扼杀在<错误：帝国信标超出范围>内部的发展。

<请求紧急监控部门派遣人员到坐标19c14a05……失败。重试……失败。重试…>
descriptions.en:
Splendid! Guidelines will be delivered to you imminently.

In summary: Directive WAPP-715 allows for responsible, non-destructive use of the Wenkwort gardens. Great importance is attached to preserving these worlds' existing character, however we do not wish to stifle development within-<ERROR: imperial beacon out of range>.

<Requesting urgent Monitor Division dispatch to co-ordinates 19c14a05... Failed. Retrying... Failed. Retrying...>

descriptions.zh:
真令人失望。就这样吧。

<请求执法部门派遣人员到坐标—
<错误：无法找到帝国信标。还原至备份导航系统……成功。>
<执法部门已在途；预计在2个大周期后抵达。礼节协议暂停。>
descriptions.en:
How disappointing. So be it.

<Requesting Enforcer Division dispatch to co-ordinates-
<ERROR: imperial beacon could not be found. Reverting to backup navigation systems... Success.>
<Enforcer Division en route; estimated arrival 2 grand cycles. Courtesy protocols disengaged.>

descriptions.zh:
入侵者：你仍明显违反§YWAPP-715命令§!，命令要求位于[root.Planet.GetName]的温科沃特花园应以非破坏性方式使用。

这是你的最后一次机会，要么同意我方的指导方针，要么立即面临惩罚。
descriptions.en:
Intrusive entity: you remain in apparent violation of §YDirective WAPP-715§!, concerning the non-destructive use of the Wenkwort gardens at designate [root.Planet.GetName].

This is your last opportunity to accede to our guidelines, or else face swift punishment.

label.zh: 我们接受你命令中的条款。
label.en: We accept the terms of your directive.

tooltips.zh: 向[root.GetName]添加§Y温科沃特监护者§!修正。

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……
descriptions.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Embarrassed surveyors have already begun looking into their sudden appearance. It would seem [From.Planet.GetName] has a prior history...

options.script:
name = OK
create_archaeological_site = relicrails_digsite

descriptions.zh:
发掘进行没多久，设计更为错综、建造更加牢靠的隧道和设备就显露了出来。宽轨铁轨与卧铺列车保存状况良好，周围还有各式各样的遗物以及扔了几个世纪的垃圾。

在这些残骸中留有各种经过精心阳极氧化处理的引擎和信号设施部件，和§Y维修站§!里会有的东西一样。所有部件上都刻有精致而复杂的几何图样，或许这其中有高级的艺术技巧，甚至曾令人引以为豪。
descriptions.en:
It wasn't long before our excavations revealed tunnels and equipment of sturdier construction and more intricate design. Heavy-gauge rails and sleepers lie preserved and intact, surrounded by myriad relics and centuries-old garbage.

Amongst the debris lie various precisely-anodized pieces of engine and signalling equipment, such as one might find in a §Ymaintenance depot§!. All are inscribed in singular detail with complex, geometric patterns - suggesting high levels of artistry and perhaps even pride.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们在对一条狭窄辅道试探性发掘时，找到了一个死去多时的爬行动物，死因是大约§Y800年§!前发生的顶板塌陷。遗体出现在这条隧道里的原因一开始是个谜题，但我们在对其身上携带的许多武器进行研究后找到了答案。

发现的带刃工具中有许多挂在一顶装饰性盾牌的内侧，制造这些工具的技术和我们比起来只能算原始，但却与在隧道轨路上使用的技术明显不同。这位带着盾牌的来访者如同我们一样，并不属于这颗星球，而且看起来还在进行与我们类似的考古研究，直至在隧道中丧生为止。
descriptions.en:
Our chance excavation of a narrow side-tunnel has revealed a long-dead reptilian occupant, whose demise by ceiling collapse dates back some §Y800 years§!. Their presence in this tunnel was something of a puzzle, solved only when we completed a study of the many weapons found on their person.

The technology underlying these bladed implements - many of which were mounted on the inside of a decorative targe - is primitive compared to our own, yet markedly different to that used on the railroad. This targe-bearing visitor was as alien to this world as we are, and they seem to have been conducting similar archaeological research - that is, before the tunnel claimed their life.

options.script:
name = federations3.1015.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
负盾者的记录把我们带到了一座§Y变电站§!，这座变电站曾经用于维持这个维修场。看起来他们的探险打破了该设施的气密封印；这里很少有腐烂的迹象。布满灰尘的电缆管道在几十个监视器周围形成柱廊。正是在这样一个通道上，我们发现了残留的来自§Y另一感性物种的§!遗迹。

负盾者的探险队称这是一群软体动物技术人员——他们仍然保存完好的尸体挤在一起，以相互保护或取暖。记录中还记录了两次试图重新启动这个有千年历史的变电站的尝试，但使用的工具都不如我们的。我们有机会完成这项工作，这样做会使进一步的挖掘工作更容易。
descriptions.en:
The Targe-bearer's notes have led us to an §Yelectrical substation§! which once served this maintenance yard. It looks like their expedition broke an atmospheric seal on the facility; there are comparatively few signs of decay here. Dust-covered cable ducts form colonnades around dozens of monitors. It is down one such aisle of monitors that we found trace remains from §Ysentients of a different species§!.

The Targe-bearer's expedition described this as a group of molluscoid technicians - their still-preserved bodies huddled together for mutual protection or warmth. The records also note two attempts to restart the millennia-old substation, using tools which are inferior to ours. There's a chance we could complete this effort - and in so doing, make further excavation much easier.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
就在我们利用一台便携式相位发生器，从[From.Planet.GetName]上启动变电站的几分钟后，该设施突然响起刺耳的警报。几秒钟后，就在我们的挖掘小组工作的地方，部分天花板和铁路旁边的一段墙壁坍塌了。

故障已经被追踪到一个我们以为它是不相连的§R腐蚀的电阻器线圈§!。这一疏忽造成了几人受伤，并决定了我们挖掘队十多名队员的命运；他们现在正步上了负盾者的悲惨的后尘。
descriptions.en:
Mere minutes after we jump-started the substation on [From.Planet.GetName] using a portable phase generator, the facility erupted with piercing alarms. Seconds later, part of the ceiling and a section of wall adjoining the railroad collapsed, right where our excavation team was working.

The fault has been traced to a §Rcorroded resistor coil§!, which we'd thought disconnected. This oversight caused several injuries and has sealed the fates of a dozen members of our dig team; they now follow in the Targe-bearer's tragic footsteps.

descriptions.zh:
这个变电站遗迹的复杂性让我们吃惊。我们用一台便携式相位发生器启动了它，但随之而来的爆炸活动导致我们周围有千年历史的建筑部分坍塌。

幸运的是，我们的队伍得到了足够的预警，找到了避险处。他们发现一些地区现在已经被完全封锁，但一些新的地区已经取而代之地开放。
descriptions.en:
This relic of a substation has surprised us with its complexity. We jump-started it using a portable phase generator, but the ensuing burst of activity caused parts of the millennia-old structure around us to collapse.

Fortunately our team had sufficient warning to find shelter. They emerged to find some areas now firmly closed off, but some new areas have opened in their stead.

options.script:
name = site_success
fromfrom = { add_stage_clues = 1 }

descriptions.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外“改造”暴露了一条长距离的铁路隧道，根据我们破译的控制面板，一列火车躺在那里，隐藏在侧边。同时，这个系统也对列车应用了不同的优先级标记，包括一个我们称之为“§Y仓库§!”的词。

因为很少有一个关键的人工制品以这样大的形式出现在我们面前，我们派去一个团队让火车再次启动。古董火车头本身就是一件足够优雅的工程，但它背后每一辆精心装饰的汽车都被证明是一座博物馆。

火车最好被理解为一个漫游的时间胶囊，随时准备被移动到安全的地方。三千年来，它保存了整个现在我们知道他们管自己叫做叫做§Y皮耶普§!的文化的历史、文化和科学记录。
descriptions.en:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site exposed a long-distance rail tunnel down which - according to the control panels we deciphered - a train lay, tucked away in sidings. Those same systems had applied various priority markers to the train, including a word we've identified as '§Yrepository§!.'

A team was dispatched to get the train moving again, for rarely does a key artifact come to us in a form as large as this. The antique locomotive is an elegant enough piece of engineering in itself, but every one of the elaborately-decorated cars behind it has proven to be a museum in its own right.

The train may best be described as a roaming time capsule, ever ready to be moved out of harm's way. For 3,000 years it has preserved the historical, cultural and scientific records of an entire culture, whom we now learn called themselves the §YPeeyeps§!.

label.zh: 带回这些记录回我们的母星作进一步研究。
label.en: Bring these records back to our homeworld for further study.

descriptions.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外改造暴露了一个货场，它是从一个巨大的拱形洞穴屋顶下凿出来的。在它众多巨大而空无一人的仓库中，只有留下了一个安全封条没有启封；在重新打开的时候，我们发现了更多的负盾者的尸体。他们来这里寻找补给，却与一个有千年历史的警报系统发生冲突。

根据他们留下的日志，这个巡回的§Y芬鲁尼尔远征队§!正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]是否为宜居世界。他们没有料到会在这里发现废墟。由于没有受过训练，对考古学也不感兴趣，他们对遗址进行了彻底的搜查，而不是进行调查。

那些在仓库里挨饿的人用特别生动的语言指出，他们的同志把大量的物资运到货船上，几乎没留下什么。我们自己的调查证实，尽管有大量的古董机器，但几乎没有什么东西能告诉我们这些神秘的铁路建造者是谁。
descriptions.en:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site has exposed a goods yard, hewn from under a vast and vaulted cave roof. Of its many vast and vacant warehouses, only one had its security seals tripped; upon re-opening it we found the remains of more of the Targe-bearer's people. They had come seeking supplies, only to fall foul of a millennia-old alarm system.

According to the logs they left behind, this itinerant '§YFenrunir Expeditionary Group§!' was investigating [From.Planet.GetName] as part of a habitable worlds survey. They hadn't anticipated finding ruins here. Untrained and uninterested in archaeology, they ransacked the site rather than investigating it.

Those who met with starvation inside the warehouse note - in particularly colorful language - that their comrades removed a great deal of material to their freighters, leaving little behind. Our own surveys confirm that although there is an abundance of antique machinery, little else remains to tell us who the enigmatic railroad-builders were.

options.script:
name = UNFORTUNATE
owner = { large_artifact_reward = yes }

descriptions.zh:
来自[From.From.Planet.GetName]的铁路建造者留下的记录告诉我们这群狂热的软体动物是如何逃离他们对恐惧科技的家园，通过机械化的努力来寻求更好的自我。他们撤退到一个神秘而遥远的§Y地下洞穴网络§!，后来通过铁路隧道连接和扩大了它们的栖息地。

由于担心他们的文化有一天会被猎杀和消灭，皮耶普人为了安全在地下修建。在接下来的200年里，他们的社会发展缓慢，在此期间，他们的家乡的政府变得更加孤立和偏执。一次激进的转变就促使他们以前所未有的规模进行军事化；就在这时，编年史突然结束了。

即使有了随后的负盾者自己不完整的发现，我们也只能推测两国人民的悲惨命运。进一步的考古证据要么丢失了，要么没有记录下来；现在唯一剩下的就是他们的隧道，他们的记录和他们的火车。
descriptions.en:
The records left by the railroad-builders of [From.From.Planet.GetName] tell how this fervent band of molluscoids fled their technophobic homeland, seeking to better themselves through mechanical endeavor. They retreated to a secret and distant network of §Yunderground caves§!, later linking and expanding their habitats by means of railroad tunnels.

Fearful that their very culture may one day be hunted and eradicated, the Peeyeps built deep - for security and preservation. Their society grew slowly over the next 200 years, during which time their homeland's government turned more insular and paranoid. A single, radical swing provoked them into militarization on an unprecedented scale; at this point the chronicle ends abruptly.

Even with the Targe-bearer's own subsequent, patchy findings, we can only speculate upon the tragic fates of both peoples. Further archaeological evidence has either been lost or gone unrecorded; all that remains of the Peeyeps now are their tunnels, their records and their trains.

descriptions.zh:
我国各处的多个研究站探测到了以[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地为中心，超空间中存在的轻微变形。这一效应在“真空”中表现为局部的类极光现象，居住在恒星基地上的人员将其描述为一种色彩鲜艳的气态卷须，包裹着整个空间站。

此外，我们在[root.GetAllianceName]中的盟友报告称他们的首都星系出现了类似现象。总统[discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName]已呼吁立即对此事开展合作调查。
descriptions.en:
Various research stations across our empire have detected subtle distortions in hyperspace, centered upon the starbase at [root.Capital.GetName]. The effect presents in 'real space' as a localized aurora, which starbase inhabitants describe as brightly-colored, gaseous tendrils enveloping the station.

Furthermore: our allies in the [root.GetAllianceName] report similar phenomena in their capital systems. President [discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName] has called for an immediate and coordinated investigation into this matter.

tooltips.zh: [root.GetAllianceName]各成员国获得一个§H特殊项目§!，以对这些现象间存在的关联进行联合调查。
tooltips.en: Each member of the [root.GetAllianceName] will be tasked with a §HSpecial Project§! - a joint effort to find what links these phenomena.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[root.Capital.GetName]中极光状云团的调查解决了一些问题，但提出了更多疑问。这些形态各异的卷须状云团会在我们向盟友的研究队伍发出通讯光束后出现，但也只有这样才会出现。每朵云都略带红色，边缘凹凸不平，移动方式躁动。

单靠我们自己无法从这些行为中分辨出进一步的含义——但在§Y全体成员国结果汇总后§!，[root.GetAllianceName]应该会有更多答案。

初期理论猜测这些跨维度实体以某种方式与我们的超空间通讯频段产生了谐振。这次意外的引诱或许可以用来进一步利用这些实体进行研究，或者我们可以切换频率，希望这些云团会消散。
descriptions.en:
Our investigation of the aurora-like cloud at [root.Capital.GetName] raised more questions than answers. Distinct tendrils of cloud form whenever we beam communications to our allies' research teams - but only then. Each is tinged with red, appearing jagged at the edges - and they move in an agitated manner.

On our own, we are unable to discern any further meaning from these behaviors - but the [root.GetAllianceName] expects to have more answers once §Yevery member's results are collated§!.

A vivid, cyan tint within the gas gives it the appearance of a planetary aurora - only its various bands will spontaneously switch from sweeping curves to right-angles, as though forming a digital wave.

descriptions.zh:
在对我们的研究结果进行比对后发现，这些在我们联邦成员国首都盘绕的、看似没有知觉的极光状云团事实上组成了一个单一的有生命实体。

研究者们能得出的结果如下：这个居住在超空间的实体因为事故漂移到了我们联邦的宇域，它被“钩在”我们最为繁忙（也就是为我们首都的恒星基地提供服务）的太空通讯中继器上。研究者一致同意这个气态实体之前正§H尝试重组自身§!，如果不是现在的状况，它处于碎片状态下是做不到这件事的。

在重组完成后，这朵云消失了，它回到了超空间中——但在此之前它到访了我们联盟中的许多研究站。在每个研究站，它多次准确地穿入穿出超空间，在旁观者看来如同舞蹈一般。云朵展示了它穿越超空间屏障的本能，这为我们提供了无价的数据。
descriptions.en:
The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

As best the researchers can tell: this hyperspace-dwelling entity drifted into our federation space by accident, whereupon it became 'snagged' on our busiest, spaceborne communications relays - those which serve our capital starbases. Researchers agree that the gaseous entity was §Hattempting to reconstitute itself§! - a task it could otherwise not achieve in such a fragmented state.

After it reformed, the cloud disappeared back into hyperspace - but not before visiting a number of our alliance's research stations. At each one, it performed a number of precise movements in and out of hyperspace - a display which some witnesses describe as resembling a dance. These demonstrations of the cloud's innate ability to traverse the hyperspace barrier have provided us all with invaluable data.

我们收集到的数据并不完整，但足以推断出我们遭遇了一个格式塔存在：这个气态存在适于居住在超空间中。项目合作者提出理论，认为这朵云的各个部分在漂移过我们星系时被“钩在”了首都的恒星基地上。它似乎想要§H重组自身§!——但由于我方没有一致为其提供帮助，这朵云的某些部分渐渐散去，不再能参与到重组中了。

那些成功重组的部分随后消失去了超空间之中；余下的部分可以继续为研究者提供关于超空间的、有趣的遥测数据。
descriptions.en:
The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

The data we have is incomplete, but is enough to suggest we have encountered a gestalt being: gaseous in form, and adapted to dwelling in hyperspace. Project coordinators theorize that various parts of the cloud became 'snagged' on our capital starbases whilst it drifted through our galaxy. It appears to have wanted to §Hreconstitute itself§! - but without a united effort on our part, some of those clouds have begun to lose cohesion, and may no longer be able to rejoin.

Those parts of the cloud which did reunite soon vanished into hyperspace; what remains continues to provide researchers with interesting telemetry on matters relating to hyperspace.

label.zh: 这样的话，或许能从中得到某些益处。
label.en: Some benefit may yet be gleaned, then.

descriptions.zh:
由于我们没有对这一项目进行合作研究，关于这个造访我们首都的跨维度云团，我们很难确切得到些什么。理论众说纷纭，但我们都观察到这些云团变得相当躁动。

它们的物理结构开始解体，我们注意到这些云团对于刺激的反应也减少了。它们开始更为迅速地穿入穿出超空间。这在我们的通讯频段上产生了显著的静态干扰，但也为[root.Capital.GetName]的理论研究者提供了宝贵的数据。
descriptions.en:
With no collaborative effort having been applied this project, little can be said with any certainty about the pan-dimensional cloud visiting our capitals. Theories abound, but all of us are now witness to these clouds' stormy agitation.

As their physical structure breaks down, we note that the clouds become less responsive to stimuli. They have begun phasing in and out of hyperspace much more rapidly. This is generating a significant amount of static on many of our communications bands, but it is also providing valuable data for our theoretical researchers in [root.Capital.GetName].

tooltips.en: §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§! receives a temporary boost to cohesion.

descriptions.zh:

我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。

Similar occurrences have also been reported on worlds overseen by our colleagues in the [from.Federation.GetName]. They have responded by forming a committee led by [event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName], there to co-ordinate any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

他们要求我们提供自己的额外资源，以便我们能够更好地理解这件奇怪的麻烦事。
descriptions.en:
Our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] report a deafening hum from sources thought to lie buried on at least one of their worlds. A research committee has been established to support any excavation efforts they make.

We have been asked to provide our own, additional resources, in order that we might all better understand this strange and inconvenient occurrence.

label.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
label.en: We will lend what support we can.
We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh:
我们未能向同事提供他们要求的额外隔音罩。好在设备匮乏只会阻碍他们的工作，并不会彻底阻止他们挖掘。但是，这还是让一线研究人员更加不安。纵使报告显示噪音现在正自己减弱，他们的情绪也没有任何好转。

[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会现在邀请我们研究声音本身，看看能否得到些许启发，以此来弥补我们之前的过失。
descriptions.en:
We have failed to provide our colleagues with the additional acoustic shielding they had requested. This lack of equipment will only hamper their efforts, and won't stall them outright. Nevertheless, it has left their front-line researchers that bit more rattled, even after reports which suggest that the noise is now subsiding of its own accord.

The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee now invites us to make amends by contributing to a study of the sound itself, to see if that may shed any light.

The co-ordination committee now asks us to assist with a matter of data analysis.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh: 我们未能得出令人满意的成果，[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会对此表示失望。困扰联邦内多个星球的噪音终于消失，但研究机会的窗口也随之关闭。研究人员尽自己所能收集了一些信息，但现在只能寄希望于现场的考古学家能够给出详细的答案。
descriptions.en: The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee expresses its disappointment in our lack of results. As the din which has afflicted a number of our federated worlds finally dimmed, so too did the window of research opportunities close. Researchers gathered what insights they could, but any hope for detailed answers now rests solely with the archaeologists on the ground.

descriptions.zh: 联邦境内处考古遗址中的嗡鸣已经开始减弱。通过研究每种声音的录音，并将我们与同事的数据进行交叉对比，我们发现，当震耳欲聋的嗡鸣相互重叠时，会产生惊艳绝伦的和声，旋律可绕梁三日，令人心旷神怡。对于建造这些遗址的人来说，这种设计可能具有文化意义，但我们可能永远无法了解其中的含义。研究仍在继续……
descriptions.en: The humming at archaeological sites across our federation's space has begun to subside. By studying recordings of each sound - and cross-referencing our data with that of our colleagues - we discovered a surprising harmony as each deafening blast overlaps to form a more pleasant, ambient melody. It's possible that this arrangement held cultural significance for whoever developed these sites; we may never know. The research continues...

titles.zh: 声震屋瓦的贝壳形建筑

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们必须断断续续地轮班工作，但从技术上讲，揭开这个遗址的奥秘非常简单。我们挖开了两层平平无奇的岩石，然后才看到一个大贝壳，也可以说是穹顶。此外，附近有一些相同的穹顶也已部分出土，目前看来，这些穹顶似乎排列成弧形或圆形。

每个穹顶都是用模子建成，并且进行过一定程度的加固，能够经受地质年代的考验。每个建筑都有会议室大小，因此应该能够进入其中。
descriptions.en:
The work of uncovering this site was technically straightforward - despite our having to work in staccato shifts. We removed two featureless strata before encountering a large shell or dome. Other, identical domes have been partially uncovered nearby; so far they seem to be arranged in an arc or circle.

Each dome was constructed from a mold, and was cured to such a degree that they have withstood geological ages. Ingress to these structures - each of which is the size of a gathering hall - should be possible.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们尚未确定无处不在的嗡鸣的来源，但其主导地位已经开始有所减弱。自此以后，我们的研究人员就能够专注突破这座类似半球的建筑。

里面的空间完全没有实际内容，我们初步结论为，此建筑是按感官隔离室设计的。此外，穹顶的内表面似乎画有星座图，辅以神话人物和某种形式的经文。我们正在努力解读这些设计。
descriptions.en:
While we have yet to identify the source of the pervasive humming, its dominating presence has begun to wane. Our researchers were since able to focus on breaching the near-hemispherical structure.

The space within is entirely devoid of material contents; our initial conclusion is that this was designed as a sensory isolation chamber. Furthermore, the inside surface of the dome is illustrated with what appear to be constellation charts, supplemented by mythical figures and some form of scripture. We are already working to interpret these designs.

titles.zh: 贝壳形建筑的内部结构

descriptions.zh:
我们在穹顶内部发现了大量精巧的设备，但没有一台能够产生我们在外面还能听到的巨大噪音。一支小规模的工作小队已经独立出去，继续我们的调查工作。

大部分研究人员还留在这个贝壳形结构中，研究其内部机制，设备结构复杂，装饰美观，乍一看像是某种大型计算器。
descriptions.en:
We discovered a plethora of elaborate equipment inside the dome, none of which seems capable of producing the immense noise we can still hear outside. A small task force has split off to continue that aspect of our investigation.

The bulk of our researchers remain within the shell-like structure, studying the mechanisms within. The equipment is intricate, decorative in form, and seems at first glance to be some form of vast calculator.

descriptions.zh:
来自[from.owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都确认：嗡鸣现已消失。尽管各星际遗址之间距离遥远，但嗡鸣声几乎在同一时间停止。

从那以后，我们的研究团队依据穹顶内部描绘的众多星座推断出了一些模型，这些星座通常用于占星预测。研究人员收集的数据表明，此设施，若是按年代排序，比周围地层要古老得多——但有一处明显的例外：研究人员偶然在穹顶外面发现了一个大型祭坛，这表明在相对较近的年代，至少有一个文明曾使用过这一空间。

祭台使用当地的石头凿成，上面雕有蚀刻图，我们认为这些蚀刻图是用来翻译穹顶上的古老星图，将其转化一个现今我们更为熟悉的星图。
descriptions.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the droning sirens have now dissipated. They ceased almost simultaneously, despite the vast distances between interstellar sites.

Since that time, our research team has extrapolated models from the many constellations depicted on the dome's interior, which seems to have been used to make astrological predictions. The data they've gathered suggests that this facility is far older than the surrounding strata, by an order of epochs - with one notable exception: the chance discovery of a large dais immediately outside the dome suggests that at least one civilization has used this space comparatively recently.

The dais was hewn from local stone, and is decorated with etchings we believe were used to translate the dome's outdated star charts for a galaxy arranged much as it is for us, now.

descriptions.zh:
来自[from.owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都表明：困扰我们共有空间各处研究遗址的嗡鸣声已经消失。这让我们的研究人员如释重负，因为他们可以开始研究穹顶内安置的复杂设备了。

尽管其设计古怪之极，但我们仍然辨认出，该设备由相互连接的太阳系仪组成。这些模型描绘了整个[from.system.GetName]星系和另外两个恒星系，但我们以及联邦内的同事至今仍不知道这两个星系的名称和位置。每台太阳系仪都由一组轴和齿轮驱动，支撑着无数由方解石和石化树液制成的雕塑。尽管看起来一动不动，但实际上它们正以缓慢的速度移动——就像巨大的星系时钟的一枝一节，而时钟的“钟声”可能就是我们先前听到的巨大嗡鸣。
descriptions.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the ringing hum which was plaguing research sites across our shared space has now dissipated. This came as relief to our researchers as they investigated the complex equipment arranged inside the dome.

Although its design is eccentric in the extreme, we've identified it as an arrangement of interlinked orreries. These models depict the entirety of [From.Planet.System.GetName] along with two other star systems, whose names and positions are not yet known - to us nor our federation colleagues. Each is driven by a nest of axles and gears, supporting myriad sculptures in calcite and fossilized sap. Although they appear quite still, they are actually moving at a glacial pace - like parts of a vast galactic timepiece, whose 'chimes' might be the great siren we heard earlier.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[from.Planet.GetName]和其他地方穹顶的研究已结束。每个遗址都是巨大的占星设备，跨越星际的距离与其他设备同步。

我们的研究表明，这类设施被视为宇宙能量的汇聚点，影响着建造设施的古老文明的总体“位置感”。蚀刻记录中提到，议会将“引导”这些能量，从而指引其帝国的命运。

他们的社会最终依然走向衰落，这种仪式并没有为其逆天改命。但在之后的一千年中，出现了一个继业的文明，这一继承者文明翻译并恢复了这一仪式。那之后，他们也离开了这些地方，不知去了何处。

这块巨大的时钟至少已经见证了两个文明的兴衰。现在，时钟的自动嗡鸣召唤着我们，让我们在太空区域各处见证这一仪式。无论是否会有确切结果，至少[from.owner.Federation.GetName]已经准备好进行观察了……
descriptions.en:
Our study of the domes on [From.Planet.GetName] and elsewhere has reached an end. Each site is a vast astrological device, synchronized with others like it across interstellar distances.

Our studies suggest that facilities like this one were treated as focal points for cosmic energy, affecting a general 'sense of place' for the ancient civilization which built them. Etched records speak of councils who would 'channel' these energies in order to guide their empire's fortunes.

Such observances did not halt their society's eventual decline, but in the millennia which followed there also came an inheritor who would translate and revive the practice. They too have since left these sites, for parts unknown.

The vast timepiece has slowly ticked on through the periods of at least two civilizations; its automated siren has now called on us to observe this ritual at sites across our region of space. Whether or not anything tangible results from it, the [from.owner.Federation.GetName] is now poised to observe...

descriptions.zh:
有人可能会说，我们直到最后一刻才收集完数据。联邦最新成果刚刚发布没几天，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几个圆顶遗址就突然活跃起来，一束束光从地下深处飞流直上，正好映照在我们首都上方，这让人难以置信。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。广播只传达了一个目的，即宣告这件事成为“§H求索的时刻§!”。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续缓慢地像时钟一样滴答地走过一个个时代，当然也包括我们当下的时代。
descriptions.en:
One might say that the last of our data was gathered in the nick of time. Mere days after the last of our federation's findings was published, each domed site within [from.Federation.GetName] space burst into life. Cascades of light spilled upwards from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. The broadcast 'spoke' with singular purpose, proclaiming this to be a '§HTime of Knowing§!'.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their glacial 'ticking' through ages which now include our own.

descriptions.zh:
一刹那，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几座圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。尽管还不清楚广播的目的，但人们共同见证这一景象凸显出一种§H平衡繁荣§!的情感氛围。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续神秘而缓慢地像时钟一样滴答作响。
descriptions.en:
Each of the once-noisy, domed sites within [from.Federation.GetName] space has, for a brief moment, burst into life. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. It's unclear what the broadcast was intended for, but a commonly-shared observation highlights feelings of §Hbalanced prosperity§!.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their mysterious, glacial 'ticking'.

descriptions.zh:
整个[from.Federation.GetName]的智能生物都为眼前突然出现的宏伟景象所震惊。与此同时，几年前发现的古老圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员对这种梦幻般的景象感到非常困惑。目前我们还不清楚这一现象的目的，也没有观测到后续现象，因此无法获得更多线索。我们似乎错过了对其加以研究的时机。
descriptions.en:
Sapients throughout the [from.Federation.GetName] have been startled by a sudden, apparent hijacking of visual feeds which coincided with a burst of activity from ancient, domed sites discovered some years ago. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers on [root.Capital.GetName] are puzzled by this broadcast of dreamlike visions. It's unclear what it was intended for, and no subsequent phenomena have been reported which might lend us more clues. It would seem that we have simply missed an opportunity to study this phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员们以圣灵之名汇聚一堂。我们在各自的信仰之间找到了共同点，但联邦内仍然还有着多种信条、宗教和教会，和谐共处并不容易。

最近，僧团的成员敦促[Root.Federation.GetName]主持一场主教会议，以便共商起草一份联合教条，定义我们信仰的根基。这个提案被通过了，每一个[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员都要派出他们的代表。
descriptions.en:
The members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] are united around their spirituality. We found common ground in the fact that we are believers, but the federation is home to various creeds, faiths and churches and cohabitation is sometimes uneasy.

Lately, members of the clergies have been pushing for the [Root.Federation.GetName] to hold an Ecumenical Council, where we could gather to try and outline a unified dogma, and define the core tenets of our beliefs. The idea was approved, and every member of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has been asked to send representatives.

label.zh: 我们派往联邦的特使就能胜任
label.en: Our envoy in the Federation can handle this

label.zh: 简直莫名其妙。路上随便找群人派过去吧。
label.en: This is nonsense. Only send a token delegation.

label.zh: 我们对这个奇怪的议程不感兴趣。
label.en: These peculiar proceedings do not concern us.

descriptions.zh: 今天的议题是“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”，我们的使团用最华丽的辞藻和无可辩驳的逻辑作出了一场令人印象深刻的陈辞，从气势上彻底碾压了那些反对者我们观点的声音。得益于我们的精彩表现，对手陷入了沉默并且会议很快得出结论。各国使团希望能因我们的智慧而给予嘉奖。
descriptions.en: During today's debates about "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", our delegation made a brilliant display of rhetoric and implacable logic, virtually crushing those arguing against our point of view. With the opposition silenced, a conclusion was swiftly reached thanks to us. Other delegations wish to honor us for our wisdom.

label.zh: 我们来此不图名利。礼貌拒绝。
label.en: We're not in this for prestige. Decline politely.

label.zh: 这群笨蛋离了我们就是废物！
label.en: These fools would get nothing done without us!
As if things could have gone any other way!

descriptions.zh: 关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”这个问题相当地微妙，相关的议论刺激着许多敏感的神经。具体来说，我们的使团非常固执己见，并且对各国的高级教士屡屡出言不逊。他们纷纷要求我们正式致歉。
descriptions.en: The question of "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" is a delicate one and many sensitivities where hurt in the discussions surrounding it. In particular, our delegation was most headstrong and has been recorded insulting several other high ranking prelates from other empires. They have requested an official apology from us.

label.zh: 这种举止简直丢人。我们道歉。
label.en: Actions like these are not acceptable. Apologize.

label.zh: 一群煞笔！我们就是这样，怎么着。
label.en: Dimwits all! We stand by what we said.

label.zh: 显然一些小礼物应该能让他们理解个中缘由。
label.en: Surely a few presents should help them to see reason.

titles.en: Ecumenical Council: A Matter of Precedence

descriptions.zh: 在讨论“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”这个话题之前，议会要求使团们在一位高阶教士的领导下进行平静的冥想。由于议程制定不详细，有三位显赫的主教都认为他们自己才应当主持这场仪式。氛围变得焦灼了起来，随着他们争吵的升级，会议不得不延期举行。
descriptions.en: Before discussing the topic of "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", the delegations were supposed to be led in peaceful meditation by a high ranking prelate. Due to imprecisions in the schedule, three prominent priests thought that they would be the ones to lead the ceremony. The situation escalated and their bickerings have brought the council to a halt.

label.zh: 哪个蠢货安排的议程？这会议简直就是个笑话。
label.en: Who even organized this?! This council is a joke.

label.zh: 这种事情不可接受。提出正式谴责。
label.en: This behavior is unacceptable. Issue an official reprimand.

label.zh: 重新安排议程，让他们几个获得想要的关注。
label.en: Rearrange the schedule to give them the attention they seek.

descriptions.zh: 关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”的激烈讨论让每一位与会嘉宾都备受刺激情绪激动。为了缓和气氛，会议决定让每一个国家都互相交换礼物以及友谊的象征。我们要送些什么呢？
descriptions.en: The intense debates around "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" left everyone agitated and in high temper. To appease things, it has been decided that every empire shall offer gifts and tokens of friendship to the others. What should we send?

label.en: Present them with the sacred Imperial [GetSpeciesShavings].

descriptions.zh: 今日关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”的关键辩论被一位突然闯入的高级教士打断了，他拖着两位不同使团的成员。这两人被撞见时正在述说着对彼此跨越种族的恒久爱恋。较为保守的特使们认为他们的行为很不体面而且已经接近异端行为，有辱这场会议的神圣性。
descriptions.en: The day's crucial debate about "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" was suddenly interrupted when a prelate came in, dragging along two members of different delegations. They were caught professing their undying love to each other, despite their differences. The more conservative envoys view their behavior as disrespectful and borderline heretical, violating the sanctity of this holy congress.

label.en: They are a symbol of unity!
Offer them a fast track to sacrifice.

descriptions.zh: 在激烈争论“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”一整天之后，按照其中一个使团的习俗举行了宴会。宴会的一个环节是向各位嘉宾呈上仪式性的酒水。对于那个使团的物种而言这是一种很弱的致幻剂，但对我们而言则反应强烈。仅过了一小会儿整个房间就陷入了混乱的斗殴中。所幸事态平息后没有人受到严重的伤害，但调查认为是我们的特使最先动的手，要求我们对此道歉。
descriptions.en: After a long day spent discussing "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", a feast was held following the custom of one of the delegations. As part of it, a ritual draught was served to everyone. To them, it is a mild inebriant, but our delegation had an extreme reaction to it, and moments later, the room erupted in a general brawl. Things have settled down and no major injuries have been reported, but we are regarded as having started the fight, and are expected to issue an apology.

label.zh: 行，把他们全都送到一颗死寂星球静养去吧。
label.en: Send everyone on a meditative retreat on a tomb world.

descriptions.zh: 在下决心主持会议时我们就知道，通向联合教条的路必定长满荆棘，但我们还是低谷了荆棘到底长得有多满。几个月毫无意义的争吵没有得出任何结论，反而是让我们更加意识到互相之间的不可调和。我们决定等过一段时间再提这事了。
descriptions.en: When we decided to hold the council, we knew the road to a unified dogma would be long and hard, but we underestimated just how long and how hard it would be. Months of sterile debates have done nothing but highlight everything that separates us from each other. We have decided to wait a while before trying again.

descriptions.zh: 我们确是受到眷顾的。最后发现，我们一开始忧心忡忡的事情不过是杞人忧天，一切进行得都无比丝滑。精准的理论和发人深省的演讲使我们成功地编撰出了和谐的新教条文集。我们很快会再重新修缮一回，但现在它已经成为了联合信仰的基础，拉近了彼此之间的距离！
descriptions.en: Truly, we are blessed. Whatever apprehensions we had going in have been proven wrong and everything went quite smoothly. Precise theology and inspired discourse have allowed us to create a harmonious corpus of our new dogma. We will surely revisit it later, but for now, it will serve as the foundation of a unified faith that will bring us closer to each other!
